cargo_profile: release, thin LTO, one codegen unit
scope: Identical checked column representation and source, ordinary Arc scalar spines versus immutable packed chunks. Complete typed and JSON calls include observation, publication and acknowledgement. Exact portable snapshots and abort preservation checked; startup, population, checkpoint, restore and teardown measured separately. Uninstrumented alternating samples and separate requested-heap counting allocator. No C/JS/Wasm timing, automatic selection or universal performance claim. Restore timing includes teardown of restored state; acknowledgement is included in update phases. Snapshot digest verifies the two artifacts execute the same workload.
